name: obi-band
title: Obi Band
description: The paper promotional band wrapped round the lower part of a manga volume. It takes a 2:3 cover (an image URL, or any node) and overhangs it by a few pixels at the bottom, with a 2px ink line on each side and a fold strip at the start edge. Tones: accent (the kit's one colour), ink (an ink flat) or paper (a screentone strip on the top edge only). Sizes sm, md, lg set the band height (26, 34, 42 % of the cover). The headline scales with the cover width through container queries, so it works on a 120 px cover too. An optional badge is a burst at the band's end corner. Static, not interactive.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/obi-band". Give it the cover as an image URL or as a node (the 2:3 box is drawn for you). Put it in a column of the width you want: the band follows that width, and the text follows the cover.

meta.tagline: A promotional band wrapped round the lower part of a volume.
meta.usage:
import { ObiBand } from "@/components/manga/obi-band"

<ObiBand
  cover="/covers/night-rail-2.jpg"
  headline="Over 2 million copies"
  caption="Now a major series"
  badge="NEW"
  tone="accent"
  size="md"
/>

props.name: cover
props.description: An image URL (object-cover), or any node drawn as the cover. Takes precedence over children.

props.name: children
props.description: Drawn in the 2:3 box when no cover is given.

props.name: caption
props.description: A small line under the headline.

props.name: badge
props.description: A short word in a burst at the band's end corner, e.g. "NEW".

props.name: tone
props.description: accent: the kit's accent · ink: an ink flat · paper: paper with a screentone top edge.

props.name: size
props.description: Band height: 26 %, 34 % or 42 % of the cover.
